page.overview:
Who is Mozuu the Chosen?

is an Uruk in service of Sauron created for Critical Role One-Shot: Shadow of War – Part 1 and 2. is played by Darin De Paul.

Mozuu enjoyed bragging about his personal conversation with Sauron to everyone he met. However, when confronted with a ringbearer, he confessed that he had made up the conversation entirely.

Mozuu always has access to these spells.

In addition to his oath spells, Mozuu has access to 1st through 2nd-level paladin spells. As a 5th level paladin with a +0 charisma modifier, he can prepare 2 of these spells per day.
